name: @aptd3v/containerkit
description: Compose projects, Dockerfiles, and Engine actions as TypeScript components.
author: aptd3v

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p coexist-test/tsconfig.json && node --import ./scripts/register-containerkit.mjs --test dist-test/node.test.js dist-test/render.test.js dist-test/jsx.test.js dist-test/eslint.test.js dist-test/plan.test.js dist-test/runner.test.js dist-test/docker-file.test.js dist-test/vocab.test.js dist-test/live.test.js dist-test/hooks.test.js dist-test/taskflow.test.js bin/containerkit.test.js scripts/publish-optional.test.js scripts/containerkit-loader.test.js
scripts.terminal: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && go build -C .. -o dist/containerkit ./cmd/containerkit && CONTAINERKIT_BIN=../dist/containerkit node --import ./scripts/register-containerkit.mjs dist-examples/terminal/terminal.js
scripts.nginx: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && go build -C .. -o dist/containerkit ./cmd/containerkit && CONTAINERKIT_BIN=../dist/containerkit node --import ./scripts/register-containerkit.mjs dist-examples/nginx/docker.js
scripts.wordpress: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && go build -C .. -o dist/containerkit ./cmd/containerkit && CONTAINERKIT_BIN=../dist/containerkit node --import ./scripts/register-containerkit.mjs dist-examples/wordpress/docker.js
scripts.mongo-replica: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && go build -C .. -o dist/containerkit ./cmd/containerkit && CONTAINERKIT_BIN=../dist/containerkit node --import ./scripts/register-containerkit.mjs dist-examples/mongo-replica/docker.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node scripts/publish-optional.mjs check
